title: TABLESTYLE group-90/91 enum projection and bounded edit
mode: ODA/Autodesk API cross-check plus generated ASCII/Binary DXF and local DWG roundtrip

authoritativeReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeReferences.finding: The value data type enum lists 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and R2007+ 512; unit type lists 0, 1, 2, 4, and 8. TABLESTYLE's R2007+ group 90/91 use those ACAD_TABLE definitions.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk TABLESTYLE DXF reference
authoritativeReferences.finding: Groups 90 and 91 are cell data type and cell unit type, repeated for each table-style row/cell style.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk TableStyle.SetDataType (2018)
authoritativeReferences.finding: The row-style API accepts Autodesk DataType and UnitType enums, directly binding the semantic enum domain to TABLESTYLE row settings.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk DataType enumeration
authoritativeReferences.finding: Lists the documented DataType numeric values, including General=512.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk UnitType enumeration
authoritativeReferences.finding: In addition to ODA's common unit codes, lists Currency=16, Percentage=32, and AngleNotTransformed=65536.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk TableStyle.Format method
authoritativeReferences.finding: Confirms there is a row-type-specific format string property, but does not state its TABLESTYLE DXF group code.

authoritativeReferences.title: Autodesk TABLE DXF reference
authoritativeReferences.finding: Documents group 4 as a standard/title/header row format string on TABLE; this is not evidence that group 1 is the DXF mapping for TABLESTYLE.

researchConclusion.resolved: The DXF-facing DataType/UnitType API enum values can be projected as opaque scalar values and edited only in present group-90/91 slots.
researchConclusion.unresolved: ODA v5.4.1's serialized DWG unit-type list is narrower than Autodesk's API enum; API-only unit codes are therefore not emitted in DWG until producer-authored drawings establish version-specific acceptance. ODA documents DWG TABLESTYLE format text as group 1, but Autodesk's TABLESTYLE DXF reference omits that field and separately assigns TABLE group 4 to row-format text, so a TABLESTYLE DXF mapping is not inferred.

changes: R2007+ TABLESTYLE DXF parsing and bounded raw-carrier editing validate documented DataType and UnitType API enum codes.
Only existing paired group-90/group-91 slots are editable; omitted slots remain omitted, raw order is preserved, and untouched ASCII source spellings remain unchanged.
The typed DXF writer emits the scalar enum codes without interpreting table values or converting units.
DWG reader parsing can retain documented API enum codes, while DWG writer validation remains limited to ODA's explicitly enumerated unit codes 0/1/2/4/8.
Generated ASCII/Binary controls cover valid API-only units, invalid enum refusal, sparse slot refusal, sentinels, raw-net preservation, and typed readback.
